project.name: Porch Light
project.summary: emPOWER tells you how many. Porch Light tells you who to call first, and why: when a hurricane or tornado warning drops, it gives a county emergency manager a ranked, explained call sheet of the dialysis centers and nursing homes inside the warning area, with proof of where every number came from.

builders.name: Joe Gaither
builders.role: owner: decides, reviews and merges; agents write the code

zetaris.how: Zetaris is the only door to data. Every read is federated SQL through the Query Director over a Unified Semantic Layer (porch_light_usl) with declared relationships and DQ rules; Nemotron proposes joins, Zetaris SQL measures each one's match rate, and only measured joins become USL relationships. Every fact on the call sheet carries its Zetaris query id and audit row.
data_sources: Iowa Environmental Mesonet NWS warning archive

meterless.how: Meterless is the only model path: the app talks to one OpenAI-compatible base URL on Meterless Runtime (Nightshift), routing meterless/deep, fast and local. Scout Intent guards the export and signs an execution contract; H-MEM with TrustLedger remembers measured join outcomes and links every claim to fact and query ids; a minimal World Model holds alert, area, check-in, network and provider state. Markovian and Swarm are not used.

nvidia.how: Nemotron is the only model family in the runtime path. It proposes join paths and writes every call-first explanation and call script (it never ranks; a fixed formula does). Super VL and Lightning run on NIM through Meterless; Nano 9B v2 and Nano 4B run locally on the RTX 5080 for EOC snapshot mode; Content Safety screens scripts; Parse splits the county plan PDF.
